channel.title: Projects on Wenhua Wang
channel.description: Recent content in Projects on Wenhua Wang

item.title: AI-Based Initial Margin Service
item.description: Accelerating regulatory Initial Margin (IM) calculations with a dual-engine architecture: a PyTorch deep learning sensitivity emulator and a financial NLP parser (Llama-3), validated under SR 11-7 model risk management guardrails.

item.title: QuantLib AI Risk Lab
item.description: An agentic risk analytics platform combining QuantLib, Pydantic, and LLM orchestration for natural-language-driven risk computations.

item.title: AI-Assisted Tax Reporting
item.description: End-to-end bookkeeping-to-tax-preparation automation: PDF ingestion, OCR extraction, LLM structuring, category mapping, and multi-format tax export.

item.title: DistributeX: Scaling Legacy Quant Engines
item.description: DistributeX wraps legacy, thread-unsafe quantitative libraries and exposes them as distributed, polyglot tasks. Architecture, design trade-offs, and runnable demos in C++, Python, Java, and C#.

item.title: QuantLib Python Library Extension
item.description: Extends QuantLib Python with symbol-based lookups, centralized calendar and schedule management, a flexible curve builder, and class-level decorators that accept strings and integers where objects were previously required.

item.title: Serverless Finance: Moving Computation to the Browser
item.description: Exploring WebAssembly, gRPC, and hybrid patterns for computational finance; interactive WASM pricing and gRPC for heavy compute.

https://bill18.github.io/post/project-2/ Full implementation of option pricing models from Espen Haug’s reference — Black-Scholes, binomial trees, Greeks, implied volatility, and exotics — with a Swing calculator UI. Modernized with Java 8 lambdas and streams. Part of the code has been rewritten with new features in Java 8, e.
